title: Barliman: trying the halting problem backwards, blindfolded - William Byrd, Greg Rosenblatt
summary: A Clojure/conj 2016 talk demoing Barliman, a prototype smart editor that does program synthesis. Given a partial program and tests, it completes the program using a relational interpreter written in miniKanren.
why: HN people point to it as an amazing demonstration of relational programming and program synthesis that still looks exciting after LLM code generation.

quote.text: I work on miniKanren, which is a logic programming language with a complete search that doesn't hit the nontermination issues you mention.
